snapshot.stores: NONE this half. Card forbids psql, Neon URI mint, and any store connect. Live counts are UNMEASURED. Planner runs the SQL.
inputsRead: hauska-factory src/jobs/seed.mjs (payload is the adopted thin object)

missionPremise: Jurisdiction is spatial containment against tx_city_boundary, not a breadth_* alias. A parcel outside every incorporated polygon is the real disposition unincorporated (_decisions/2026-08-30_unincorporated_is_the_disposition.md). The alias seed is name-normalisation for the 48 percent that carry a string. Persist waits on the P2 job template and is out of this half.

design.store: cortex neondb (deployment store). Tables: tx_city_boundary (1222 incorporated polygons, btree bbox), tx_county_boundary (254), txgio_parcel (rings + bbox; DISTINCT county_fips, prop_id). Not hauska_mcp atoms. Not Factory landing. Not cad_property (no geometry).
design.joinShape: Zone-major. cities AS MATERIALIZED builds 1222 geoms once. Parcels join onto city bboxes (west/south/east/north inequality), then ST_Intersects. Point-major LATERAL (FROM parcel, LATERAL city lookup) is forbidden; measured ~218x slower on this store.
design.place_fips: substring(geo_id from 3). CPA geo_id is 48 + 5-digit place_fips (Austin 4805000 -> 05000, Kyle 4839952 -> 39952, Bastrop 4805864 -> 05864).
design.unincorporated: LEFT JOIN from every in-universe parcel. No hit after the threshold is disposition unincorporated, place_fips NULL. Not a null, not a CDP name, not unknown.

threshold.coupland_vs_floor: sliver is 76x smaller than the floor; refused
threshold.applies_to: polygon-polygon hits (parcel-city and city-county). Point / bbox-centre hits have no area; ST_Intersects(point, city) is the test and method is labelled bbox-centre.
threshold.why_not_fraction: A relative floor (1 percent of parcel) would reclassify large rural rings that nick a limit and would move the 624,141. Absolute floor kills Coupland-class slivers without adopting a new split.

design.caldwell: Measured join used bbox-centre because 48055 carried no usable ring. SQL: if ST_MakeValid(ring) is empty or not a polygon, use ST_Point((west+east)/2,(south+north)/2) and set method=bbox-centre. Do not launder those as ring containment. If bbox columns are also unusable, disposition=unresolved (reported, not rounded into unincorporated).
design.universe: txgio_parcel WHERE county_fips IN (48021,48055,48209,48309,48453,48491) AND prop_id IS NOT NULL. DISTINCT ON (county_fips, prop_id). Measured per-county denominators to reconcile: 62257 / 24989 / 116421 / 114255 / 380918 / 282570 = 981410.
design.straddles: File-side roster: 72 touching, 69 primary in the six, 24 with more than one all_county_fips, 3 primary outside (Golinda 30092 parent 48145, Staples 70052 parent 48187, Thorndale 72776 parent 48331). city_manifest.payload is the adoptRoster thin object (place_fips, name, parent_county_fips, rails) and dropped all_county_fips. This half specifies the 72-row restore and a live city-county re-derive with the same 1e-8 floor so Coupland 17312 drops 48453. Persist job writes it.
design.alias: 225-row seed is a TEMP table. proposed_place_fips is never written onto a parcel. Disagreement (string place vs containment place) is a result row. Containment wins.
design.cdp: No place_fips for Driftwood, Cedar Creek, Del Valle, Dale, China Spring, Elm Mott, Axtell, Paige, McDade. Assertion: zero tx_city_boundary.city_name in that list; zero assigned place_fips whose city_name is in that list.
design.timeout: SET statement_timeout = '180s' on the parcel join (city-county equivalent was 1.3s; 981k with btree bbox should land well under 180s if zone-major). Probes 30s. A timeout is a finding, not a zero.
design.reconcileRule: Totals must match 357269 unincorporated / 624141 in-city / 981410. A material divergence means this join is wrong, not that the number is new. Named in SQL comments and the close.

adversarial.risk: Threshold moves thousands of boundary parcels and the split no longer matches 357269/624141
adversarial.response: Floor is 1e-8 deg2 (~107 m2), 76x the Coupland sliver. SQL emits both thresholded totals and a sliver-only count (intersects AND overlap < 1e-8). If thresholded totals diverge materially, the join is wrong; do not adopt the new number.

adversarial.risk: Caldwell bbox-centre is silently treated as ring containment
adversarial.response: method column is ring | bbox-centre | unresolved. Totals broken out by method. Amendments already flagged 48055 as bbox-centre; the SQL keeps that label.

adversarial.risk: Point-major LATERAL sneaks in as a convenience for one-parcel probes
adversarial.response: Probes reuse the same cities MATERIALIZED + bbox join. 05_explain.sql must show no SubPlan LATERAL from parcels.

adversarial.risk: Restoring roster all_county_fips blindly re-imports Coupland as a Travis city
adversarial.response: 03 re-derives city-county with the 1e-8 floor. Persist writes the spatial array, not the roster array, where they disagree. Disagreement is recorded.

adversarial.risk: Alias seed consumed as jurisdiction for the 48 percent
adversarial.response: 04 is SELECT-only reconcile. No UPDATE. Containment column is the authority.
